text:
alex: Heads up — Zenith Logistics just notified us the H200 batch lead time slipped ~14 days. We have 50 units in our provisioning queue. If we refuse the delay they can offer a 1:1 RMA swap with refurbished units but there's an additional per-unit fee. Need routing decision: cross-dock refurbished to NA or wait for original shipment? @maria @kevin please advise.

maria: Clarify numbers — 14 days is the new estimate? Which serials are earmarked for EU vs NA?

elaine (Zenith Logistics): Confirmed — ship date moved from 2026-04-01 -> 2026-04-15 (approx). The 50 units are pre-tagged: 32 NA, 18 EU. We can split and do a partial RMA now: 20 refurbished units to NA available immediately. Cost: refurb fee $350/unit + freight. We can provide AWB after PO amendment.

kevin: Cluster impact — if NA loses 32 we fall below our 5% spare margin for east-cluster. Prioritize NA. If we accept 20 refurb to NA now + 12 next week we should keep SLOs. @finance-bot what's the unit economics vs waiting?

finance-bot: Quick calc: waiting 14d = estimated lost revenue/risk ~ $2.8k/day for impacted services (historical). Refurb fee + expedited freight ~ $17k total. Net: refurb path likely cheaper than SLA/regression costs given our current traffic profile.

tara: Ops preference — route refurb -> NA via bonded cross-dock, tag as 'temp-pool' with 30-day return policy. For EU: push original shipment but pre-clear customs docs now to avoid extra delays. :thumbsup:

defon: Small correction — need two things before cross-dock: (1) serial->node mapping plan, (2) ephemeral pin in inventory for the 'temp-pool'. I can script auto-tagging. Example command to assign pool:
```
inv assign --pool temp-na --sku H200 --count 20 --tag rma_refurb_2026_04
```

matt: Customs note — if refurb enters NA via bonded X-dock we can avoid duties until permanent allocation; need broker signoff. Vendor can label paperwork as 'refurbished components' to reduce tariff class. @elaine can you confirm paperwork wording?

elaine (Zenith Logistics): Yes — we can supply commercial invoice marked 'refurbished components' and route through bonded warehouse. Tentative AWB: ZLX-20260402-NA-01 (pending manifest). If shipped today ETA to NA dock is ~3 business days.

alex: Plan then — accept partial refurb 20->NA via bonded cross-dock; hold the remaining 30 for standard shipment. Action items: @devon run inventory assign script, @maria update PO to include refurb fee and new invoice terms, @kevin update rollout priority to protect east-cluster. I'll open the RMA ticket and post AWB when it's live.

maria: On it — sending amended PO now and tagging cost center 'infra-temp' so finance can track the temporary expense.

kevin: Will throttle noncritical training on east cluster, shift some traffic to west reserve. Monitoring latency; will flag if errors >5%.

ops-bot: New RMA created: RMA-8921. Link: https://rma.internal/reports/RMA-8921 — assigned to @alex. Status: pending vendor pickup.

finance-bot: Cost estimate uploaded: https://finance/internal/sheets/infra-refurb-4312345679 — please review before PO finalize.

alex: Thanks all. If vendor pushes new delays we'll regroup. :raised_hands:
